Title: 로컬 로그온 허용 설정
Description: 로컬 로그온 허용 권한에 Administrators, IUSR만 존재하는지 검증 및 조치
CheckCommand: $temp = "$env:TEMP\sec_w11.inf"; if (Test-Path $temp) { Remove-Item $temp -Force }; secedit /export /cfg $temp /quiet; if (Test-Path $temp) { $line = Get-Content $temp | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*SeInteractiveLogonRight\s*=\s*(.*)$" } | Select-Object -First 1; Remove-Item $temp -Force; if ($line -and $Matches) { $val = $Matches[1].Trim(); $accounts = $val.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Replace("*", "") }; $ok = $true; foreach ($acc in $accounts) { if ($acc -ne "S-1-5-32-544" -and $acc -ne "S-1-5-17" -and $acc -ne "Administrators" -and $acc -ne "IUSR") { $ok = $false } }; $ok.ToString() } else { 'False' } } else { 'False' }
RemediationCommand: $temp = "$env:TEMP\sec_w11_rem.inf"; secedit /export /cfg $temp /quiet; if (Test-Path $temp) { $content = Get-Content $temp -Raw; if ($content -match "(?m)^\s*SeInteractiveLogonRight\s*=") { $content = $content -replace "(?m)^\s*SeInteractiveLogonRight\s*=.*", "SeInteractiveLogonRight = *S-1-5-32-544,*S-1-5-17" } else { if ($content -match '\[Privilege Rights\]') { $content = $content -replace '\[Privilege Rights\]', "[Privilege Rights]`r`nSeInteractiveLogonRight = *S-1-5-32-544,*S-1-5-17" } }; $content | Set-Content $temp; secedit /configure /db "$env:TEMP\sec_w11.sdb" /cfg $temp /quiet; Remove-Item $temp -Force }
